ledger: 0:00 exterior: single-story diner; front facade = centered double glass door flanked by windows, lit OPEN neon in front-right window; gravel lot with white sleeper semi idling to building's left; open flat land beyond

0:12-0:18 counter area: waitress on kitchen side wiping counter; warm-lit kitchen pass-through window with plate shelves in wall behind her; brown door beside pass-through; customer stools on dining side

0:20-0:28 wide interior: booths under windows along left wall, service counter with stool row along right wall, kitchen pass-through down-range in right wall, front wall shows OPEN-sign window with door to its right (interior view); man enters via front door, walks booth-counter aisle, sits at counter
0:30-0:33 coffee poured from glass pot into white mug on counter; man's hands resting at counter
0:34-0:37 breakfast plate (cornbread + fried egg) close-up on counter; blurred booth tables with condiment bottles across aisle
0:38-0:44 man seated at counter with plate and mug facing kitchen side; front windows dark (night) behind him
0:46-0:52 kitchen POV through pass-through: man seated at counter, front door with red EXIT sign and glass showing night exterior directly beyond him
0:53-1:00 transition beat: counter empty, pass-through lit, warm dawn glow in front windows (clear time skip)
1:01-1:10 crossfade to daylight: man at counter with mug; road with passing cars and building across visible through front windows; neon OPEN now unlit (daytime)
1:11-1:19 waitress serves fresh breakfast plate across counter to man
1:21-1:28 waitress rounds counter end to dining side, sits on adjacent stool with her own mug
1:29-1:37 both at counter; low sunrise sun over open land through window behind them; beverage cooler against wall nearby
1:38-1:42 man lays cash bills on counter beside mug; waitress's hand receives payment

1:43-1:47 through front window: man crosses gravel lot toward green day-cab box truck (different rig than 0:00, consistent with overnight time skip); truck position matches lot left of door as mirrored through window
1:47-1:51 waitress inside watches through window, her reflection overlapping glass
1:53-1:57 final wide: sunlit diner, waitress walks back toward kitchen; booth/counter/door arrangement matches established plan
